Markra editor source from markrahq/markra commit 797fff96880bed494ebbd8b1b27b9666ef04d6ee, release 2.14.6.

The editor, Markdown and shared directories contain the runtime source of the corresponding upstream packages. The AI file contains only the editor's imported types. Vendored code retains the upstream AGPL-3.0-only license in LICENSE. Local changes cover QingYu's table controls, paste and copy behavior, task controls, heading and list layout, note links, and diagram formats, and narrow a frontmatter input event type.
